deepdive.sec: Electrical & Electronic Instrumentation — measurement / metering / power-quality + current transformers, with HPDC aluminium die-casting and an emerging solar-inverter line

bull_bear.body:
- Net debt free; net cash ₹1,276 mn (31-Mar-26).
- Dividend 20% (₹2/share) declared; investor pushed for sustained ≥20% payout, mgmt receptive.
- Inorganic growth a stated strategy — actively scouting US, Europe, India; nothing material to announce. Reinvesting profits.
- Possible Alucast demerger/divestment under consideration (no decision).
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- Geopolitics repeatedly flagged: West Asia war, oil/petroleum shortage, tariffs, lockdown "rumors" — all guidance caveated on "normal working."
- Alucast still PAT-negative (-₹41 mn FY26); turnaround depends on long qualification cycles; double-digit margin pushed to FY28. Demerger uncertainty.
- Solar: not yet cost-competitive vs Chinese mass-manufacturing in India ("close, but not for profit"); no government support that China enjoys; US requires full UL re-design (slow lab queues); Europe solar declining (pivoting to Middle East).
- US data-center timing risk: if products/certifications arrive late, relegated to replacement market.
- FX: euro/PLN-INR translation skews reported Polish numbers; rupee at ₹85 noted.
- OEM-vs-own-brand channel conflict in solar (mgmt downplays).
- Investor pushback that US growth ($3→4.5 mn, ~₹12-13 cr increment) is "underachievement" given portfolio.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident, candid and granular. Beat their own FY26 EBITDA guidance (₹110 cr → ₹126/136 cr) and acknowledged it explicitly. Honest on weaknesses — solar not yet China-competitive, US growth modest, Alucast still loss-making at PAT level. Backed Alucast recovery with "concrete data, not wishful thinking" (offers given, audits cleared, negotiations). Promoter (Goliya) added dividend and demerger color directly. Repeated explicit geopolitical caveats — neither over-promising nor alarmist.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- **CTs are the quiet data-center & grid play:** "one product goes behind every meter in every data center," UL-certified, capacity +67% (6k→10k/day) — most concrete monetization of the AI-capex theme, not the headline solar story.
- **Lumel SA is the profit engine, not India:** 51% of group PAT from a "subdued" European market — group quality hinges on Poland electronics, with EU-funded SMT line as a moat for SIL-rated MV controllers.
- **Alucast is the swing factor:** the entire 161% EBITDA jump largely came from plugging Alucast's ₹150 mn loss, not organic EEI alone — FY27 growth must come from EEI as Alucast goes flat (one-time benefit won't repeat).
- **Solar is optionality, not a thesis:** ₹24-25 cr FY27 on lower (15-20% GM) margins; mgmt itself frames it as a "bamboo tree" just sprouting; hybrid + Middle East/Saudi export is the real call option.
- **US acquisition is being actively explored** specifically to beat the data-center certification clock — potential inorganic catalyst.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body:
- **Standalone Rishabh (India):** consistent performer; high-margin export wins; largest CT maker globally by value/volume — 6,000 CTs/day, expanding to 10,000/day.
- **Lumel SA (Poland):** 51% of group PAT, 23%+ EBITDA. Commissioned one of Europe's most advanced SMT/electronics assembly lines (40% funded by EU; for next-gen complex MV controllers, SIL 1/SIL 2). Does MV protection relays/controllers.
- **Lumel Alucast (Polish HPDC):** planned shrink — exited ~₹100 cr of loss-making legacy auto contracts (₹250 cr → ₹180 cr business). Cut from 3 shifts to 2; turnaround real but FY27 is volume-rebuild year. Possible demerger floated by investor — mgmt: "a possibility, no decision."
- **STI USA/UK, V&A China:** all EBITDA-positive, fast growth on small base. Microsys (software) acquired to bundle solutions for data centers.

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

latest_quarter.body:
- FY26 gross margin 554 bps higher at 54% (vs 48.6%) on product mix + buying diversification/efficiency, employee & other costs in check.
- Product contribution margins span 20% (solar, EMS) to 60-70% (power-quality analyzers); blended EEI EBITDA ~24% in FY26 but mgmt deliberately conservative, guiding 20-22% because richer-mix solar volume can dilute %.
- EEI passes through input cost increases (own brand/products/pricing). Energy-efficiency products are counter-cyclical to high European energy prices (ISO 50001 / ESG compliance demand).
- Alucast hampered structurally by European labour/energy costs; mgmt argues many EU competitors have closed → projects shifting to survivors + dual-sourcing trend supports recovery.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body:
**This quarter (Q4/FY26):**
- Consol EBITDA margin Q4 16.2% (+760 bps YoY); FY26 16.3% (+960 bps). PAT +292% FY26.
- Beat self-set ₹110 cr FY26 EBITDA guidance (₹126 cr reported / ₹136 cr adj).
- Lumel Alucast turned adj-EBITDA positive (+₹33 mn vs -₹150 mn) — main driver of group jump; still PAT-negative.
- Dividend reinstated/declared at 20% (₹2/share).
- Nashik 2-facility expansion completed, under commissioning (capacity ~2x).
- Lumel SA SMT line commissioned (40% EU-funded).
- Solar iUNO single-phase launched, turned unit-profitable; ₹24-25 cr FY27 target.
- US revenue $3 mn (+50% YoY); CT capacity expansion 6k→10k/day underway.

**Next-quarter / FY27 watch items:**
- Verify EEI 20-25% growth & 20-22% EBITDA materializing in Q1 FY27.
- Nashik facilities full commissioning by June/July — watch ramp.
- Solar inverter ₹24-25 cr trajectory + hybrid launch + OEM deals.
- Alucast: new RFQ conversions, flat top-line (~₹180 cr constant currency), no-loss confirmation; demerger decision.
- US: $4.5 mn target, possible US acquisition announcement, new UL-certified products.
- MV VT/PT design completion by end-FY27 (sales FY28).
- Geopolitics / oil / FX (euro-PLN-INR) impact on reported numbers.
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log

outlook.body:
- **EEI segment FY27: 20-25% top-line growth (anchored ~20%), EBITDA 20-22%.** Same guideline as last year (which they beat). Rishabh standalone & Lumel SA (~85% of EEI) each ~20%; smaller STI/V&A (~13-15%) ~30%.
- **Solar inverters FY27: ~₹24-25 cr (roughly doubling).** US business FY27: $4.5 mn (+~40-50% off $3 mn), aspiration ₹100 cr in 3-4 yrs.
- **Lumel Alucast FY27: flat-to-slightly-lower vs ₹238 cr (target ~₹180 cr constant currency), no losses, no growth.** Double-digit margin only in FY28, not FY27.
- **Medium-voltage VT/PT products: design ready by end-FY27, sales from FY28.**
- **FY28 aspiration (in response to investor):** "close to" ₹1,000 cr revenue & ~₹150-160 cr adj EBITDA — mgmt would not firmly commit to ₹1,000 cr crossing.
- *Next-quarter (Q1 FY27) explicit number: none given — guidance is annual.*
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body:
- No consolidated order-book figure disclosed (B2B instrumentation, book-and-ship). Demand described as "healthy, sustainable" across export and domestic, "strong order pipeline."
- Alucast: multiple RFQs in progress; a few approved, several in price/T&C negotiation — ~3-4 new customers + 2-3 new projects from existing customers; volumes land "order booking + 1 year" (i.e., FY28).
- Data-center: won + repeat projects from Sify (India); similar in UK supporting Ireland; developing US-specific products.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body:
- **Medium-voltage expansion:** CTs already released; MV protection relays (Lumel) + CTs (Rishabh) live; VT/PT design ready end-FY27. No high-voltage intent ("too diverse").
- **Solar inverters:** iUNO single-phase (≤10 kW) launched Q3-Q4 FY25 with strong response; NEO 3-phase up to 50 kW; now operationally/unit profitable (gross margins 15-20%, lower than core). Hybrid single-phase in development → opens Middle East / Saudi / Europe export. Dual go-to-market: own brand + OEM supply to Indian brands that currently assemble Chinese SKDs. New Nashik floor can scale solar to ~₹100 cr with incremental assembly lines.
- **Data centers / AI capex:** CTs behind every meter (UL-certified) is a key US growth driver; bundling products + Microsys software; exploring US acquisition to fast-track certification and "catch at least half" of the 5-6 yr capex wave before it becomes replacement-only.
- **EMS / semicon (PLI-linked):** doing complex assemblies incl. laptop motherboards (a former-Intel-principal customer); cam switches a planned new line.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: A diversified global electrical-instrumentation franchise (world's largest CT maker by volume) that turned the FY25 mess around — consolidated EBITDA up 161% and PAT up 292% in FY26 — riding 20-25% EEI growth on grid/metering/data-center demand, while the loss-making Polish die-casting drag has been neutralized and solar inverters become a small new optionality.
